title: Sarah Drew and Peter Mooney Play Christmas Music, Talk ‘Mistletoe Murders’ on Hallmark Radio
summary: 'Mistletoe Murders' stars Sarah Drew and Peter Mooney host the latest episode of the Count Down to Christmas Countdown SiriusXM's Hallmark Radio.
body_markdown:
It’s beginning to sound like[Christmas](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/holiday-music-channels-2026) for Sarah Drew and Peter Mooney.


The *Mistletoe Murders* stars host the latest episode of the C *ount Down to Christmas Countdown* on SiriusXM’s[Hallmark Radio](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/hallmark-radio) .


[Sarah Drew & Peter Mooney Count Down to Christmas Countdown Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogHolidayChannels2026)


During the episode, Sarah and Peter play their favorite holiday tunes, share their yearly family traditions (or extreme elf-ing as Sarah calls it), and tease what’s to come on season 3 of *Mistletoe Murders* . Listen to the full episode of the C *ountdown to Christmas Countdown* on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSarahDrewHallmarkRadio) .


Sarah and Peter play songs that get them in the festive spirit, including classics by Dolly Parton, Bing Crosby and David Bowie, Sarah McLachlan and more. Sarah also plays “Go Tell It,” by Reindeer Tribe – which features background vocals by her daughter.


### *Mistletoe Murders* Season 3


Just in time for the holiday season, season 3 of the *Mistletoe Murders* premiered on Hallmark, and Sarah and Peter tease something special.


“There’s a lot to look forward to this time around,” Sarah promises. “We have more romance, more spicy, twisty, turn-y mysteries, bigger set pieces.”


Peter sums the latest season up in one word, “Explosive.”


“It’s so great to head back to Fletcher’s Grove,” he says. “To step into Sam’s shoes.”


Watch season 3 of *Mistletoe Murders* on Hallmark Thursdays at 8pm ET.


### Listen to Hallmark Radio on SiriusXM


Hallmark Radio is back for the holidays, featuring timeless Christmas music and carols that celebrate the joy of the season. Hear the songs you love including new music from this year’s Hallmark holiday movies. Hallmark Radio is the perfect way to embrace the wonder of the season with loved ones near & far. Listen all season long!
